name: Cafe Marlo
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Café Marlo in Tirol! Nestled in the heart of the Alpenland, our cozy café invites you to savor the finest Kaffee und Kuchen in a warm, rustic atmosphere.
beschreibung: The Cafe Marlo in the Stubaital valley provides a wonderful setting for a leisurely alpine break. Guests can relax in comfortable surroundings while indulging in premium coffees, freshly baked cakes, and regional snacks. Embracing traditional Austrian hospitality, the café serves classics like Melange and Verlängerter alongside freshly made sweet pastries. A popular local spot for hikers and mountain lovers to recharge and unwind in Stubaital.
